content.about: Tunisia is the northernmost country in Africa, with a Mediterranean coast and the Sahara in the south. Carthage, near Tunis, was a powerful ancient city. Its desert has sets used in famous films. Couscous and harissa are favourites.

standout.text: The amphitheatre of El Jem is one of the largest Roman amphitheatres in the world.

didYouKnow: Matmata's underground houses were used as film sets.
Chott el Djerid is a vast salt lake.
